question: Will the winner of the 2026 Vuelta a España be Roglic or Pogacar?
resolution_criteria: If the GC winner on the podium after the final stage or the first GC winner announced by the race organization is Tadej Pogacar or Primoz Roglic, resolves Yes. Otherwise resolves No.
research:
Roglič is the only one of the two riders who can still win, because Pogačar crashed out on stage 8. Going into Sept 4, Roglič was second overall, 1:45 behind race leader Enric Mas, with 9 stages left.

Two web pages I tried to open were blocked, so most of this comes from search-result summaries. A few results were dated after Sept 4 (including later stages); I left those out.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question has no URL. The deciding source is the official general classification (GC, the overall standings) on [lavuelta.es](https://www.lavuelta.es/en/news/2026/coquard-sprints-to-victory-pogacar-abandons/58418) after the final stage in Madrid on 2026-09-13.
- 2026-09-03, latest standings after stage 12: 1. Enric Mas (Movistar); 2. Primož Roglič (Red Bull-Bora) at +1:45; 3. Felix Gall at +2:06; 4. Richard Carapaz at +3:53; 5. Onley at +4:29; 6. Jakob Omrzel at +4:59. [quotidiano](https://sport.quotidiano.net/en/ciclismo/vuelta-2026-tappa-12-vince-omrzel-ordine-darrivo-e-classifica-generale-c244f6d7)
- One search summary instead put Roglič about 2 minutes back after stage 12, citing an OA Sport headline ("Roglič a quasi 2'"). I could not open that page, so treat the exact gap as somewhat uncertain. [oasport](https://www.oasport.it/2026/09/classifica-vuelta-a-espana-2026-dodicesima-tappa-enric-mas-rafforza-la-maglia-roja-roglic-a-quasi-2/)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-29: Pogačar crashed on stage 8 about 33 km from the finish and abandoned. He was leading Mas by 3:50 at the time. Reported injuries include a concussion, a broken left collarbone and a stable C7 neck fracture. **Pogačar cannot win, so the question now comes down to Roglič alone.** [Euronews](https://euronews.com/2026/08/29/pogacar-abandons-la-vuelta-after-heavy-crash-33km-from-finish), [Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/2026/08/29/tadej-pogacar-abandons-vuelta-after-crash-on-stage-eight/), [La Vuelta](https://www.lavuelta.es/en/news/2026/coquard-sprints-to-victory-pogacar-abandons/58418)
- Mas took the red jersey (the race leader's jersey) after the crash. Roglič is second, but Mas has been gaining time on him.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: Stage 13 (Almuñécar to Loja) was a breakaway day won by Wout van Aert. The GC leaders were unchanged in reports: Mas first, Roglič +1:45, Gall +2:06. Mattias Skjelmose gained about 2 minutes by riding in the breakaway. [quotidiano](https://sport.quotidiano.net/en/ciclismo/vuelta-2026-tappa-13-vince-van-aert-ordine-darrivo-e-classifica-generale-e713d522), [cyclingstage](https://www.cyclingstage.com/vuelta-2026-results/stage-13-spain-results-2026)
- 2026-09-03: Stage 12 to Calar Alto was won by Omrzel. Mas attacked 11 km from the top and gained 27 seconds on Roglič, Gall and Carapaz. [Brujula](https://en.brujulabike.com/enric-mas-proves-once-again-that-he-is-the-strongest-while-young-omrzel-wins-and-confirms-his-potential-at-calar-alto/)
- Early September: Cyclingnews quoted Red Bull as saying Roglič is "in position to strike" for a fifth Vuelta title, but that a crash before the race keeps them "realistic". I could not open the article to get its date. [Cyclingnews](https://www.cyclingnews.com/pro-cycling/teams-riders/we-are-still-careful-in-speaking-this-out-primoz-roglic-in-position-to-strike-and-win-fifth-vuelta-a-espana-say-red-bull-but-pre-race-crash-keeps-them-realistic/)
- 2026-08-29: Bryan Coquard won stage 8, and Mas inherited the lead. [Brujula](https://en.brujulabike.com/coquard-wins-pogacar-withdraws-and-enric-mas-takes-the-vuelta-lead-in-stage-8/)

## 4. Base rates
- Roglič has won the Vuelta four times (2019, 2020, 2021, 2024), and he is a strong time-triallist.
- Mas has never won a Grand Tour. He has finished second at the Vuelta three times (2018, 2021, 2022), so he has history of not closing out a win. That is general background, not a figure from these sources.
- Leaders who still hold red after stage 13 usually go on to win, but deficits of under 2 minutes with a time trial still to come have been overturned before. I did not find a formal statistic on this.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Before the race, Manifold had Pogačar winning at about 86%. That no longer applies. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Jessef0226/will-tadej-pogacar-win-the-2026-vue)
- Polymarket has a "Vuelta a España 2026: Winner" market. Undated snapshots in search results showed only Gall, at 6 to 9%. I could not get current prices for Mas or Roglič. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/es/predictions/cycling)
- I found no bookmaker odds dated around Sept 3-4.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-05: Stage 14 finishes on the Sierra de la Pandera climb, a possible GC battle. [CyclingUpToDate](https://cyclinguptodate.com/cycling/vuelta-a-espana-2026-stage-14-preview-profiles-favourites-predictions-breakaway-bonanza-or-gc-battle-as-race-heads-to-sierra-de-la-pandera)
- Stage 18 is an individual time trial from El Puerto de Santa María to Jerez de la Frontera. This is part of the published route, and it is Roglič's best chance to gain time on Mas.
- Further mountain stages come in the final week. The race ends 2026-09-13 in Madrid.
- Other ways the result could change: crashes, illness or a jury penalty for Mas, and how much threat Gall, Carapaz and Skjelmose pose for the lead.
